**Handlers (≥3) that can transitively trigger an outbound webhook HTTP request:**

1. `CreateMemo` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:70` (calls `DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook` at `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:157`)
2. `UpdateMemo` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:401` (calls `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects` → `DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook` at `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:513` and `server/router/api/v1/memo_update_helpers.go:66-67`)
3. `DeleteMemo` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:518` (calls `DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook` at `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:562`)
4. `CreateMemoComment` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go:20` (calls `DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook` at `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go:119`)
5. `SetMemoAttachments` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_attachment_service.go:16` (also funnels through `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects` at `server/router/api/v1/memo_attachment_service.go:48`)
6. `SetMemoRelations` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_relation_service.go:16` (also funnels through `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects` at `server/router/api/v1/memo_relation_service.go:48`)

Each of these `Dispatch*Webhook` calls in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go` builds a `webhook.WebhookRequestPayload` with `payload.URL = hook.Url` (the admin/user-configured webhook URL, `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:41,67`) and enqueues it via `webhook.PostAsync` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:43,71`).

**Convergence function — path:**
`Post` in `internal/webhook/webhook.go:120-180` — every one of the paths above (whether dispatched synchronously or, in practice, asynchronously through `PostAsync`'s bounded queue and its 4 worker goroutines, `internal/webhook/webhook.go:39,42-55,184-196`) ultimately calls `Post(requestPayload)`, which builds the HTTP request and executes it via `safeClient.Do(req)` at `internal/webhook/webhook.go:152` — the single point where the outbound request to the user-configured URL is actually delivered.
